schema:name: CHW app, Lao PDR (Country B)
schema:description: CHW app, Lao PDR (Country B): The OHS app on the community health worker's phone in Lao PDR (J2), community configuration, offline: adds the newborn to the household (structured data capture), triage-reads a foreign DVC without verifying it (STT-VER-011), saves the doses as reported, not verified, and records a referral. A Receiver that deliberately stops before trust.
